test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct idiom to substitute the underlined segment in the following sentence.

Due to her impoverished state, most of her relatives __treated her with contempt__.

options.text: Turned up their nose at her
Gave a wide space to her

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Turned up their nose at her"** means to treat someone with disdain or contempt. (उससे घृणा या तिरस्कार से पेश आना)

 
 
• **Example: **The wealthy neighbors turned up their noses at her old, worn-out clothes.
 
 
 
• **"Impoverished"** means being in a state of poverty or lacking basic resources. (गरीब)
 
 
• **Example: **Due to her impoverished state, she often skipped meals to save money.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Came in handy** (काम आया): To be useful or convenient.

 
 
• **Example: **The extra blanket came in handy during the cold night.
 
 
 
• **Turned the corner** (मोड़ मुड़ना): To pass a critical point and start to improve.
 
 
• **Example: **After months of hard work, the company finally turned the corner and began making a profit.
 
 
 
• **Gave a wide space to her** (उससे दूरी बनाकर रखी): To avoid someone or something.
 
 
• **Example: **The children gave a wide space to the barking dog on the street.

The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. alliteration.
